note: From the chain's own allergen sheet, version 07 (19 June 2026), per serving; no serving sizes are printed. Whole loaves, bloomers and the slab cake look like whole-item values. Rows whose own numbers contradict each other (coffees, two breakfast rolls' salt and a few others) are left out. Wenzel's say everything is made where gluten, egg, milk, nuts, fish and other allergens are handled.
